release.notes:
Human Shuffle has a refreshed blue-and-teal classroom display, card-wearing teammate artwork, a larger countdown with remaining-time indicator, colored group totals and raised answer cards. The answer stays private until Reveal.

Question Bank now includes a Human Shuffle tab: search, create, edit, confirm deletion, or upload the CSV template. Existing uploads appear automatically. Prepared rounds, printable cards and points stay saved. The game can open this tab directly and refreshes its selector when you return.

Groups has compact setup controls, visible saved groupings, and clearer colored cards with member counts and role labels. Participation records and Class Analytics have improved spacing, tabs and aligned controls.

Preserves existing records and the features in 0.1.108-beta. Windows update only.
